name: Centre for Long-Term Resilience (CLTR)
summary: A London think tank, founded in 2019 by Angus Mercer, that advises the UK government on extreme risks: its biosecurity unit on the UK's Biological Security Strategy, DNA synthesis screening and mirror life, its AI unit on frontier AI regulation, misuse and incident response, and a risk management unit on how government assesses and prepares for risks. A non-profit company limited by guarantee (Alpenglow Group Limited, company 12308171), not a registered charity, funded by donations and taking no government money.

spending.source: https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/12308171/filing-history (unaudited accounts to 30 November 2025, filed without an income and expenditure account; 19 staff on average, note 3). Programme spending is our estimate: 19 staff × about £75,000 × 1.19 employer costs ÷ 80% staff share of costs ≈ $2.8M in all, 80% on programmes; see the model's cost rows.
